about: Assessment of every Mastodon security advisory for Teadeck. Checked daily by scripts/check_advisories.mjs. Each entry records the advisory’s updated_at it was assessed against; an edited advisory must be read again. Verdicts: server-only (not in Teadeck), mitigated (reaches Teadeck only through data from the instance; blocked by Teadeck's own measures, named in the note), fixed-upstream (fix is in imported client code; name the upstream commit included via upstream.lock.json), fixed-in-teadeck (needed a change here; name the commit), affected (open; act now).

GHSA-x2rc-v5wx-g3m5.summary: Lack of sanitization of user-facing URLs for remote objects can lead to XSS in misconfigured servers
GHSA-x2rc-v5wx-g3m5.note: Server fix (validating remote URLs). Teadeck shows URLs as the connected instance delivers them, so it depends on that instance; injected javascript: URLs or inline scripts are blocked by the CSP in container/nginx.conf (script-src 'self', no unsafe-inline), which the advisory names as the effective protection. Keep that CSP.
